patches.description: Build the product-teaser Details link with the canonical getProductLink(urlKey, sku) instead of hand-building it with rootLink — so this demo-team custom block (demo-system-stores/accs-citisignal) produces the same Helix-clean /products/{urlKey}/{sku} path as every Adobe canonical product block. A hand-built link keeps the SKU's case and underscores, which Helix strips when it publishes, so the link would miss the page.
patches.exit: Retires when Adobe fixes this itself: the daily gate then finds the replacement already present and opens a removal PR. Not filed upstream (owner, 2026-10-16).

patches.description: Swap the product-teaser's rootLink import for getProductLink (its only rootLink use is the Details link, now routed through getProductLink). Paired with product-teaser-sku-encoding.

patches.description: Render standard Commerce media URLs directly in the product-teaser instead of forcing every image through the AEM Assets delivery path (which breaks non-AEM-Assets image sources).

patches.description: Redirect a published PDP whose SKU no longer resolves to the native 404 instead of mounting an empty drop-in. The warm path: a previously-published PDP serves 200 from the content bus, so the CDN-404 smart-404 snippet never runs; fetchProductData resolves null for an unknown SKU and the initializer mounted anyway.
patches.exit: Retires when Adobe fixes this itself: the daily gate then finds the replacement already present and opens a removal PR. Not filed upstream (owner, 2026-10-16).

retired.description: Add reversible encodeSkuForUrl/decodeSkuFromUrl helpers and decode the SKU segment on PDP load, so SKUs with spaces/punctuation/mixed case round-trip to the Commerce API. Replaces the lossy slug + __-slash scheme (ADR-007).
retired.exit: TODO: file PR to upstream so canonical encodes SKUs reversibly; delete on merge. See ADR-007.
retired.reason: Put a reversible _HH SKU encoding in product links. Helix rewrites '_' to '-' on publish, so every SKU with '_' was published at an address no link pointed to. Adobe's own getProductLink already cleans the SKU the way Helix does, and product pages carry <meta name="sku"> (ADR-024).

retired.description: Build product links with reversible encodeSkuForUrl(sku) instead of lossy sanitizeName(sku), so the generated PDP URL decodes back to the exact SKU. Pairs with product-link-sku-encoding (ADR-007). (Id is historical — now full encoding, not just slashes.)
